verification_plane: Local Claw (independently verified against official public dataset documentation)
construction_rule: Each historical entity seed enters the oracle with one of three verification_status values: VERIFIED, HISTORICAL_ENTITY_ANCHOR_UNVERIFIED, CONTRADICTED. Seeds cannot be discarded merely because the v0.1 package is absent from the workspace; the Reopen Prompt §1 is the authoritative HO-supplied seed record. The contract itself is the source of truth for the seed list.

anchors.canonical_name: FlyWire v783 / annotation v2.1.0 — right GF (DNp01)
anchors.verification_attempted: Independent verification requires direct access to the Codex / flywire_annotations GitHub repository (https://github.com/flyconnectome/flywire_annotations) or to the neuPrint-compatible FlyWire API. The FlyWire root-ID format (7205759406xxxxxxx) is confirmed as the legitimate format for the v783 public release via the fafbseg-py documentation (https://fafbseg-py.readthedocs.io/en/latest/source/tutorials/flywire_segments.html). However, the specific root_id 720575940632499757 was not independently confirmed as the DNp01 / right GF body ID against an external primary source (e.g., Codex search, flywire_annotations.csv, or a published paper citing this exact root ID for the GF).
anchors.verification_note: Per Reopen Prompt §6, a seed that cannot be independently verified with the current allowed evidence access is recorded as HISTORICAL_ENTITY_ANCHOR_UNVERIFIED. The seed is NOT fabricated into the production run output, but the oracle retains the HO-supplied record so that the benchmark can be re-evaluated once a programmatic Codex / neuPrint / published-citation check is available.
